title: Coast Guard hoists kayaker near Cape Falcon, Ore.
description: A Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Astoria, Oregon, hoists a kayaker who was stranded on the rocks near Cape Falcon, Oregon, Aug. 16, 2014. The man was safely hoisted and transported in good condition to Coast Guard Station Tillamook Bay in Garibaldi, Oregon. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Astoria.
